items.text: Hello, Travelers!

We would like to sincerely thank all our Travelers for continuing to enjoy Shape of Dreams since 「The Starless Path」update and for sharing your thoughts and feedback with us. Since the update, we’ve been carefully reviewing your feedback, and with this patch, we’re excited to introduce Cross-Save, one of the most highly anticipated features alongside Cross-Play.

Now, no matter where you begin your dream, you can continue the journey you’ve built without interruption. We hope this gives all Travelers more freedom and convenience to explore the Rapids, wherever you choose to play.
Please see the patch notes below for the full details.
For detailed instructions, please refer to the Cross-Save Guide below.

notes.title: 🔄 How to Sync Your Latest Progress

items.text: Cross-Save does not sync your progress in real time.
To continue from your latest progress made on another device, use one of the following methods:
Select \ for the desired Profile from the Profile list.
Launch or restart the game client.
Cross-Save Codes can only be generated on consoles and cannot be generated on PC.
Each Code is a one-time-use code that remains valid for 10 minutes after being generated.
PC accounts cannot be linked to other PC accounts.
Accounts on the same platform cannot be linked to each other.
To Link three or more devices, such as PC + Console 1 + Console 2, first Link PC ↔ Console 1. Then generate a new Code on Console 1 and use it to Add and Link Console 2.
Data that is synced: Most data, including Profile progress, Statistics, Stardust, and ongoing game progress.
Server-granted cosmetics (Costumes, Emotes, Souvenirs, and Banners) are not synced.
Cloud save data is uploaded whenever you move to a new room during gameplay.

Fixed a bug in co-op games where the Corrupted Chaos window would close automatically.
Fixed a bug in co-op games where certain Costumes would obstruct other players' views.

We hope your dreams become clearer and more pleasant. We will continue to listen to your voices to create an even better journey.
We wish you a safe and wonderful journey within the dream.

items.text: Hello, Travelers!

Since the Winter Update, many of you have continued to explore Shape of Dreams and share your thoughts with us. Your feedback and gameplay experiences have been a great source of inspiration, and preparing the next update has been a very meaningful journey for our team.

The upcoming March Update aims to highlight each Traveler’s individuality further, introduce new tension to late-game challenges, and expand how you can craft and refine your builds through several new systems and adjustments.
Today, we would like to give you a preview of some of the upcoming features.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/5fa4911d55827b300d8c89a61add48c88c775519.png"]
Once a Traveler reaches a certain level, you can purchase new costumes with Stardust.
This allows you to customize your Traveler’s appearance and explore the dream world in your own unique style.
More costumes will be added in the future, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Omen of Pain and Corrupted Chaos[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/639139a7437db8792a83f40ca1d1b24cae73522a.png"]

items.text: Some areas of The Rapids have become shrouded in a mist of suffering.
Within this mist, even fiercer battles await. However, travelers who overcome these challenges will be rewarded with a special reward called Corrupted Chaos.
Corrupted Chaos grants new attributes and unique effects that could not previously be obtained from standard chaos, offering new select options for your build strategies.

notes.title: Luck and Destiny – Two New Shrines

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/8e007efecc892bf8043e7abfc5bdc61bf5ed9afc.png"]
Two new shrines will be added to help travelers complete their desired builds more strategically.
Remnants of Luck: A shrine where you can spend gold to expand your reward selection.
Remnants of Destiny: A shrine where you can sacrifice the quality of your current essence to obtain a different essence.
These shrines will introduce deeper decision-making and strategy during the build-to-select process.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/fecbb8747800868d8326d8b9bc48911f0736f3d6.png"]
This update will also include large-scale balance adjustments across the entire game.
Some builds that were excessively powerful and simplified gameplay will be adjusted, while previously underused memories and essence will receive new attention.
Our goal is to create an environment where a wider variety of builds can remain competitive.
For example, some memories that require channeling will be improved to allow dodging while casting.
Additionally, more build-select options will be introduced to improve survivability in late-game play, and the difficulty in certain worlds and situations will be adjusted.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/18f1c6f4aa4223b1a8d147003d688d37373108f5.png"]
To support even more diverse builds, new Skills, Essence, and Constellations will be added.
These new elements will help compensate for the traveler’s weaknesses and enable entirely new playstyles compared to previous ones.
We also have new souvenirs ready to make your adventures even more casual and enjoyable.
While traveling through The Rapids with these souvenirs, you may even discover new secrets hidden within the world.
We will continue improving and updating Shape of Dreams so it remains a game you can enjoy for a long time. Every piece of feedback you give us means a lot.
Please look forward to the full March update patch notes coming soon.
— Lizard Smoothie 💫
